title: Copenhagen at CoNLL--SIGMORPHON 2018: Multilingual Inflection in Context with Explicit Morphosyntactic Decoding
answer_short: de, en, es, fr, ru, sv, es, fi
answer_rationale: The languages evaluated are explicitly mentioned in the ablation study section (Text 4, source_id=41) and the results section (Text 4, source_id=43), where the performance is analyzed for seven languages: de, en, es, fr, ru, sv, and fi.
